name: prisma-fts-benchmark
description: Testbed comparing Prisma fullTextSearchPostgres vs ILIKE (contains) search performance

scripts.docker:generate: docker compose exec node npx prisma generate
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose exec node npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec node npm run seed
scripts.docker:search-analysis: docker compose exec node npm run search-analysis
scripts.docker:eav-seed: docker compose exec node npm run eav-seed
scripts.docker:eav-search-analysis: docker compose exec node npm run eav-search-analysis
scripts.docker:studio: docker compose exec node npx prisma studio
scripts.docker:setup: npm run docker:generate && npm run docker:migrate && npm run docker:seed && npm run docker:eav-seed
scripts.docker:all: npm run docker:up && npm run docker:setup && npm run docker:search-analysis && npm run docker:eav-search-analysis
